Moshi augments a text LLM backbone with a smaller audio language model (Borsos et al., 2022; Yang et al., 2023) that ingests and predicts discrete audio units. This removes the information bottleneck of text by understanding inputs and generating outputs directly in the audio domain, while benefiting from the knowledge and reasoning abilities of the underlying text LLM.
